basic_details.job_title: Jamui Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three posts in the Evening Court, Jamui – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – are open on a contractual basis, only to retired employees of the Civil Courts. Applications must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui on or before 20 December 2026, either personally or through registered post. The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui (Bihar).

content_sections.heading: About Jamui Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui, in Bihar. It seeks supportive staff for the Evening Court, Jamui, and is to be circulated to all Judgeships of Bihar, so retired Civil Court employees from other districts of Bihar can also see it.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application to: Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui. The notice prints no further postal details or PIN code. Mode: personally (by hand) or through registered post. Deadline: the application must reach the office on or before 20 December 2026. The deadline is for receipt, not dispatch. The notice does not mention an application form format, an envelope superscription or a list of enclosures.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired Court employees who have retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The notice does not print an educational qualification or an age limit; eligibility is based on retirement from the Civil Courts and the post-specific experience above. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. See the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post. The notice prints no amount. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Jamui Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly in the Evening Court, Jamui.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Jamui Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui on or before 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Jamui Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, may apply. They must be physically and mentally fit and have satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Jamui Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Jamui, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount; remuneration is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual for the Evening Court and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. Can a retired employee who faced disciplinary punishment apply?
faq.answer: Applicants must not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.
